highlights.description: **Breaking**: `evaluation` package renamed to `rubric` for clearer terminology
New `claims` package for factual claim extraction and source validation
Embedded reports support in SummaryReport for full-fidelity archival
JSON Schema for ClaimsReport with automated generation

added.description: `claims` package with claim extraction and source validation types
`Claim` type with ID, text, location, category, validation, and verdict
`SourceType` enum: external, internal, derived, subjective
`ExternalValidation` with URL, sourceType, reliability tier, and quoted text
`InternalValidation` with method, evidence path, reproducibility, and environment
`DerivedValidation` for claims calculated from other validated claims
`SubjectiveValidation` with acknowledgment and recommendation fields
`ReliabilityTier` enum: authoritative, high, medium, low
`Verdict` enum: verified, unverified, needs-review, rejected
`ClaimsReport` with metadata, claims array, summary, criteria, and decision
`ClaimsCriteria` for configurable pass requirements
`EvaluateClaims()` for computing decisions from criteria
`EmbeddedReports` field in `SummaryReport` for full-fidelity archival
`EmbedRubricReport()` and `EmbedClaimsReport()` methods on SummaryReport
`GetEmbeddedRubricReport()` and `GetEmbeddedClaimsReport()` retrieval methods
`HasEmbeddedReports()` helper for checking embedded content
`GenerateClaimsSchema()` in schema package for JSON Schema generation
Embedded `claims.schema.json` via go:embed
`cmd/genschema` tool for regenerating all JSON schemas

changed.description: `SummaryReport` now supports optional embedded reports via `EmbeddedReports` field
Schema embed.go updated to include claims.schema.json

documentation.description: Updated Report Types page to include ClaimsReport

tests.description: Embed tests for SummaryReport with embedded reports

highlights.description: Likert scale (1-5) support for human comparison studies
Inter-rater reliability (IRR) metrics for LLM calibration

added.description: `ScaleTypeLikert` scale type with configurable anchors and thresholds
`LikertConfig` with min/max values and pass/partial thresholds
`LikertAnchor` for describing score levels (value, label, description)
`StandardLikert5Anchors()` helper for standard 1-5 scale
`WithLikert5()` and `WithLikert()` methods for creating Likert categories
`LikertToCategorical()` for converting numeric scores to pass/partial/fail
Optional `NumericScore` field on `CategoryResult` for dual-scale support
`NewCategoryResultWithNumeric()` for creating results with both categorical and numeric scores
`NewCategoryResultFromLikert()` for creating results from Likert scores
`IRRMetrics` type with exact agreement, adjacent agreement, MAD, and Pearson correlation
`ComputeIRR()` for computing IRR from rating pairs
`ComputeIRRFromResults()` for comparing two sets of CategoryResults
`CategoricalAgreement` type with confusion matrix for categorical comparisons
`ComputeCategoricalAgreement()` for categorical IRR analysis

tests.description: Comprehensive tests for Likert scales and IRR metrics

highlights.description: Switch from numeric scores to categorical pass/partial/fail values
New terminal and markdown renderers for evaluation reports

changed.description: **Breaking**: `CategoryResult.Score` is now categorical instead of numeric

added.description: `render/terminal` package with ANSI-colored output and UTF8 icons

Judge metadata tracking (model, prompt, temperature, tokens)
Pairwise comparison mode as alternative to absolute scoring

added.description: Rubric and ScoreAnchor types for defining explicit scoring criteria
Range-based score anchors (e.g., 8-10 = Excellent)
DefaultPRDRubricSet with problem_definition, solution_clarity, success_metrics
JudgeMetadata type for tracking LLM model, provider, and prompt
TokenUsage tracking for evaluation cost monitoring
Observability trace/span links in JudgeMetadata
PairwiseComparison type for comparing two outputs
Position bias detection via swapped comparisons
ComputePairwiseResult for aggregating comparison results
ReferenceData and ReferenceDataset types for gold/expected data
Human annotation support with scores and labels
MultiJudgeResult for aggregating evaluations from multiple judges
Aggregation methods: mean, median, weighted, majority, conservative
Inter-judge agreement metrics and disagreement detection
Finding consolidation with severity-based deduplication
Judge, RubricID, and Reference fields in EvaluationReport

AggregateResults and AggregateWithDAG for multi-agent coordination
Box-format terminal renderer for summary reports

JSON Schema generation using invopop/jsonschema
Embedded schemas via `//go:embed` for runtime access
`sevaluation` CLI with render, check, validate, and schema commands
